scope: Roundness exactly1, literal integer Sides2..64, both Normalize states, Segment Width only. Vector is pruned solely by this output's proven dependency invariant.
reference: Independent actual native compositor CPU/GPU and EEVEE Metal field output; never copied kernel output or image lookup in production.
exactControls: RGBA alpha1; power-of-two Sides2,4,8,16,32,64 require exact Float32 words. No native zero/one width exists in this parameter domain.
stageDistinction: Native CPU MF uses double M_PI divided by Float32 Sides then stores Float32; native GPU uses its Float32 PI constant. A one-ULP stage difference is retained, not relabelled exact.
shaderCarrier: Positive width<2 encoded in three independent half-exact base1024 digits with scale2. Quantum2^-28 is no larger than any admitted width's Float32 ULP; independent native Float32 controls require exact decoded words. Native raw packed pixels and saved source remain pinned.
exclusions: Other outputs, fractional or computed Sides, other Roundness branches, Cycles live shader source, unmeasured native builds/platforms, arbitrary downstream pointwise composition, and official demo scene acceptance.
